goal.statement: The organization operates CandidateRankerEU in a controlled, auditable manner suitable for high-risk employment context.

strategies.statement: Demonstrate risk management, oversight, traceability, and evaluation coverage through evidence-backed artifacts and signed review.

assumptions: System does not auto-reject candidates without meaningful human review (conditioned in sign-off).
Model supply chain will be documented via Model SBOM before scaling.

conditions: Complete fairness/bias suite prior to scaling
Complete Model SBOM prior to scaling
